newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes mixed, commercial buying in March.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes mixed, commercial buying in March.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed mixed with nearby March higher on steady commercial buying, traders said.
"The prominent feature was Term Commodities buying March throughout the day," a trader said.
Traders said the buying was not heavy but the purchases were steady through the trading session.
New crop months were pressured by hedge selling, they said.
"Selling in the new crop appeared to be farmer hedging," a trader said.
Rice futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 300 contracts, above the 194 traded Monday.
Rice closed four cents per cwt higher to three lower, with March up four at $11.92.
